content_units: July 15 Meeting Window Overview
For   2026-07-15   in   America/New York  , the required attendees for both meetings are   Ava   and   Emma  , so the schedule must fit their shared availability first.
Shared availability highlights:
- Overlap for both:   11:00-12:00   and   14:00-17:00
To fit both a   60-minute project review   and a   30-minute hiring sync   with no overlap, the strongest block is the afternoon window.
Recommended Meeting Schedule
Meeting   Time   Duration   Required Attendees Fit   Team Attendance   Notes
Project Review   14:00-15:00   60 min   Ava, Emma both available   Ava, Ben, Chloe, Diego, Emma, Farah   Full-team attendance possible
Hiring Sync   15:00-15:30   30 min   Ava, Emma both available   Ava, Ben, Chloe, Diego, Emma   Farah unavailable after 14:30
Why This Is the Best Fit
-   Maximizes attendance for the larger meeting:   the   project review   gets   all 6 participants   from   14:00-15:00  .
-   Satisfies the must-attend constraint:     Ava and Emma   can attend both meetings without conflict.
-   Keeps meetings back-to-back:   reduces context switching and avoids scattered calendar holds.

-   Uses the only strong continuous window:   the morning overlap with Ava and Emma is only   11:00-12:00  , which is not enough to cleanly place both meetings without pushing one outside Ava's availability.
Scheduling Context
A short check of the afternoon availability:
-   14:00-14:30:   all 6 available
-   14:00-15:00:   all 6 available
-   15:00-15:30:   Ava, Ben, Chloe, Diego, Emma available
- After   15:30  , Diego is no longer available
This makes   14:00-15:00 + 15:00-15:30   the best sequence overall.
